import yaml
import requests
import re
import time
import sys

YAML_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/literature_map.yaml"
BIB_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper/references.bib"

with open(YAML_PATH) as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

papers = data.get("papers", {})

# Filter
to_include = []
for key, p in papers.items():
    if not p.get("verified", False):
        continue
    to_include.append((key, p))

# Sort by bibtex_key
to_include.sort(key=lambda x: x[1].get("bibtex_key", x[0]))

def fetch_doi_bibtex(doi, timeout=15):
    """Fetch BibTeX from DOI resolver."""
    try:
        url = f"https://doi.org/{doi}"
        r = requests.get(url, headers={"Accept": "application/x-bibtex"}, timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=True)
        if r.status_code == 200 and "@" in r.text:
            return r.text.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  DOI fetch failed for {doi}: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return None

def format_authors(authors):
    """Format author list for BibTeX."""
    formatted = []
    for a in authors:
        parts = a.strip().split()
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            last = parts[-1]
            first = " ".join(parts[:-1])
            formatted.append(f"{last}, {first}")
        else:
            formatted.append(a)
    return " and ".join(formatted)

def escape_bibtex(s):
    """Escape special chars in BibTeX values."""
    # Protect acronyms
    for acr in ["LLM", "LLMs", "NER", "IE", "NLP", "GPT", "BERT", "CRF", "FSM", "CFG", "MT", "QA",
                 "OOD", "OOV", "DNN", "DNNs", "MMLU", "GSM8K", "BoN", "MBR", "RAPS",
                 "SciERC", "CoNLL", "WNUT", "GoLLIE", "UniNER", "SelfCheckGPT",
                 "E-NER", "ReASC", "CISC", "USC", "RASC", "CoCoA", "LSC"]:
        s = re.sub(rf'\b{re.escape(acr)}\b', '{' + acr + '}', s)
    return s

def determine_entry_type(paper):
    """Determine BibTeX entry type from venue."""
    venue = paper.get("venue", "").lower()
    if any(k in venue for k in ["iclr", "icml", "neurips", "nips", "emnlp", "acl", "naacl", "eacl",
                                  "coling", "conll", "aaai", "ijcai", "sigkdd", "kdd", "hlt",
                                  "workshop", "w-nut", "findings"]):
        return "inproceedings"
    if any(k in venue for k in ["journal", "tacl", "bulletin", "transactions", "genomics",
                                  "informatics", "société"]):
        return "article"
    if "arxiv" in venue.lower() or "preprint" in venue.lower():
        return "article"
    return "inproceedings"

def make_booktitle(venue):
    """Convert venue to booktitle/journal."""
    return venue

def build_manual_entry(key, paper):
    """Build BibTeX entry manually."""
    bkey = paper.get("bibtex_key", key)
    etype = determine_entry_type(paper)
    title = escape_bibtex(paper.get("title", ""))
    authors = format_authors(paper.get("authors", []))
    year = paper.get("year", "")
    venue = paper.get("venue", "")
    url = paper.get("url", "")

    lines = [f"@{etype}{{{bkey},"]
    lines.append(f"  title = {{{title}}},")
    lines.append(f"  author = {{{authors}}},")

    if etype == "inproceedings":
        lines.append(f"  booktitle = {{{venue}}},")
    else:
        if "arxiv" in venue.lower() or "preprint" in venue.lower():
            # Extract arXiv ID from URL
            arxiv_match = re.search(r'arxiv\.org/abs/(\d+\.\d+)', url)
            if arxiv_match:
                lines.append(f"  journal = {{arXiv preprint arXiv:{arxiv_match.group(1)}}},")
            else:
                lines.append(f"  journal = {{{venue}}},")
        else:
            lines.append(f"  journal = {{{venue}}},")

    lines.append(f"  year = {{{year}}},")
    if url:
        lines.append(f"  url = {{{url}}}")
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

def replace_key_in_bibtex(bibtex_str, new_key):
    """Replace the citation key in a fetched BibTeX entry."""
    return re.sub(r'(@\w+)\{[^,]+,', rf'\1{{{new_key},', bibtex_str, count=1)

# Fetch DOI-based entries
doi_results = {}
doi_papers = [(k, p) for k, p in to_include if p.get("doi", "").strip()]
print(f"Fetching BibTeX for {len(doi_papers)} papers with DOIs...", file=sys.stderr)

for key, p in doi_papers:
    doi = p["doi"].strip()
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    print(f"  Fetching {bkey} (DOI: {doi})...", file=sys.stderr)
    result = fetch_doi_bibtex(doi)
    if result:
        result = replace_key_in_bibtex(result, bkey)
        doi_results[bkey] = result
        print(f"    OK", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print(f"    FAILED - will build manually", file=sys.stderr)
    time.sleep(0.3)

# Build final .bib
entries = []
supplementary_count = 0
normal_count = 0

for key, p in to_include:
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    role = p.get("role", "")
    is_supp = role == "supplementary"

    if bkey in doi_results:
        entry_text = doi_results[bkey]
    else:
        entry_text = build_manual_entry(key, p)

    if is_supp:
        entry_text = f"% SUPPLEMENTARY — not cited in main text\n{entry_text}"
        supplementary_count += 1
    else:
        normal_count += 1

    entries.append(entry_text)

# Write
header = "% Auto-generated from literature_map.yaml — do not edit manually\n"
content = header + "\n\n" + "\n\n".join(entries) + "\n"

with open(BIB_PATH, "w") as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f"\nDone. Written {len(entries)} entries ({normal_count} normal + {supplementary_count} supplementary) to {BIB_PATH}", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"DOI-fetched: {len(doi_results)}, manually built: {len(entries) - len(doi_results)}", file=sys.stderr)

import re

BIB_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper/references.bib"

with open(BIB_PATH, "r") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Fix mojibake: â€" -> -- (en-dash that got mangled)
content = content.replace("â€"", "--")
content = content.replace("â€"", "--")

# Fix other common mojibake
content = content.replace("â€™", "'")
content = content.replace("â€œ", "\"")
content = content.replace("â€\x9d", "\"")

# Also fix the HTML entity & -> &
content = content.replace("&", "\\&")

# Format single-line DOI entries into multi-line
def reformat_entry(match):
    """Reformat a single-line BibTeX entry to multi-line."""
    full = match.group(0)
    # If already multi-line, skip
    if full.count('\n') > 2:
        return full
    
    # Parse entry type and key
    header_match = re.match(r'(@\w+)\{([^,]+),\s*', full)
    if not header_match:
        return full
    
    entry_type = header_match.group(1)
    entry_key = header_match.group(2)
    
    # Extract fields
    remainder = full[header_match.end():]
    # Remove trailing }
    remainder = remainder.rstrip().rstrip('}').strip()
    
    # Parse field=value pairs (handling nested braces)
    fields = []
    i = 0
    while i < len(remainder):
        # Find field name
        field_match = re.match(r'\s*(\w+)\s*=\s*', remainder[i:])
        if not field_match:
            i += 1
            continue
        
        field_name = field_match.group(1)
        i += field_match.end()
        
        # Find value (handle braces and quoted strings)
        if i < len(remainder) and remainder[i] == '{':
            depth = 0
            start = i
            while i < len(remainder):
                if remainder[i] == '{':
                    depth += 1
                elif remainder[i] == '}':
                    depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0:
                        i += 1
                        break
                i += 1
            value = remainder[start:i]
        elif i < len(remainder) and remainder[i] == '"':
            start = i
            i += 1
            while i < len(remainder) and remainder[i] != '"':
                i += 1
            i += 1
            value = remainder[start:i]
        else:
            # Bare value (number, month name, etc.)
            start = i
            while i < len(remainder) and remainder[i] not in ',}':
                i += 1
            value = remainder[start:i].strip()
        
        # Skip comma
        while i < len(remainder) and remainder[i] in ', \t':
            i += 1
        
        # Skip fields we don't want
        if field_name.lower() in ('issn', 'collection', 'series', 'publisher', 'number', 'volume', 'pages', 'month'):
            continue
        
        fields.append((field_name, value))
    
    # Rebuild multi-line
    lines = [f"{entry_type}{{{entry_key},"]
    for fname, fval in fields:
        lines.append(f"  {fname} = {fval},")
    # Remove trailing comma from last field
    if lines[-1].endswith(','):
        lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
    lines.append("}")
    
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Find and reformat all entries
# Split by entries
parts = re.split(r'(?=(?:%[^\n]*\n)?@)', content)
new_parts = []
for part in parts:
    if '@' in part:
        # Check if it's single-line (DOI-fetched)
        entry_match = re.search(r'@\w+\{[^@]+\}', part, re.DOTALL)
        if entry_match:
            entry = entry_match.group(0)
            if entry.count('\n') <= 2:  # single-line or nearly
                reformatted = reformat_entry(entry_match)
                part = part[:entry_match.start()] + reformatted + part[entry_match.end():]
        new_parts.append(part)
    else:
        new_parts.append(part)

content = "".join(new_parts)

with open(BIB_PATH, "w") as f:
    f.write(content)

print("Fixed encoding and reformatted entries.")

import re

BIB_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper/references.bib"

with open(BIB_PATH, "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    content = f.read()

# Fix mojibake: the DOI resolver returned UTF-8 that got double-decoded
# \xe2\x80\x93 = en-dash, \xe2\x80\x94 = em-dash  
# But also there's triple-encoding: Ã¢â‚¬â€œ patterns
# Let's just replace all known problematic sequences with ASCII equivalents

# First: fix the properly encoded em-dashes (in comments, that's fine) 
# but in BibTeX values, use -- for en-dash ranges

# Pages typically use en-dash: replace with --
content = re.sub(r'pages\s*=\s*\{([^}]*)\}', 
    lambda m: 'pages = {' + m.group(1).replace('–', '--').replace('—', '--') + '}',
    content)

# Fix double-encoded UTF-8 mojibake (Ã¢â\x82¬â\x80\x9c etc.)
# These are from DOI resolver returning windows-1252 interpreted as UTF-8
import codecs

def fix_mojibake_in_entry(text):
    """Fix common mojibake patterns."""
    # Pattern: â€" should be -- (en-dash via UTF-8 double-encoding)
    replacements = {
        'â': '--',  # en-dash double-encoded
        'â': '--',  # em-dash double-encoded
        'Ã¢â¬â': '--',  # triple-encoded
        'Ã©': '\\'+'\'e',  # é  
    }
    for bad, good in replacements.items():
        text = text.replace(bad, good)
    return text

# Actually, let me try a different approach - detect the actual bytes
# Let me just regex-replace any non-ASCII in pages ranges
content = re.sub(r'(\d+)\s*[^\x00-\x7F]+\s*(\d+)', r'\1--\2', content)

# Fix &
content = content.replace('&', '\\&')

# Fix Frédéric (this is fine, keep as-is since it's proper UTF-8)
# Fix Rémi (fine too)

# Now reformat single-line entries to multi-line
def reformat_single_line_entry(match):
    full = match.group(0)
    # If already multi-line (>3 lines), keep
    if full.count('\n') > 3:
        return full
    
    # Parse type and key
    hdr = re.match(r'(@\w+)\{(\S+?),\s*', full)
    if not hdr:
        return full
    
    etype = hdr.group(1)
    ekey = hdr.group(2)
    rest = full[hdr.end():].rstrip().rstrip('}').strip()
    
    # Parse fields
    fields = []
    pos = 0
    while pos < len(rest):
        fm = re.match(r'(\w+)\s*=\s*', rest[pos:])
        if not fm:
            pos += 1
            continue
        fname = fm.group(1)
        pos += fm.end()
        
        if pos < len(rest) and rest[pos] == '{':
            depth = 0
            start = pos
            while pos < len(rest):
                if rest[pos] == '{': depth += 1
                elif rest[pos] == '}':
                    depth -= 1
                    if depth == 0:
                        pos += 1
                        break
                pos += 1
            fval = rest[start:pos]
        else:
            start = pos
            while pos < len(rest) and rest[pos] not in ',}':
                pos += 1
            fval = rest[start:pos].strip()
        
        while pos < len(rest) and rest[pos] in ', \t\n':
            pos += 1
        
        # Skip noisy fields
        if fname.lower() in ('issn', 'collection', 'series', 'publisher', 'number', 'volume', 'pages', 'month'):
            continue
        fields.append((fname, fval))
    
    lines = [f"{etype}{{{ekey},"]
    for fn, fv in fields:
        lines.append(f"  {fn} = {fv},")
    if lines[-1].endswith(','):
        lines[-1] = lines[-1][:-1]
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Apply reformatting to each entry
def process_entries(text):
    # Split into entries while preserving comments
    result = []
    # Split on @ but keep preceding comments
    chunks = re.split(r'(?=(?:^%[^\n]*\n)?^@)', text, flags=re.MULTILINE)
    for chunk in chunks:
        if '@' in chunk:
            entry_match = re.search(r'@\w+\{[^@]+?\}\s*$', chunk, re.DOTALL)
            if entry_match:
                entry = entry_match.group(0).strip()
                if entry.count('\n') <= 2:
                    new_entry = reformat_single_line_entry(re.match(r'.*', entry, re.DOTALL))
                    if new_entry:
                        chunk = chunk[:entry_match.start()] + new_entry + "\n"
        result.append(chunk)
    return "".join(result)

# Simpler approach: just fix the encoding, don't reformat

    f.write(content)

python3 << 'PYEOF'
import yaml
import requests
import re
import time
import sys

YAML_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/literature_map.yaml"
BIB_PATH = "/home/ubuntu/.agent-ml-research-idea_gen_0514_1/projects/struct_self_consist_ie/docs/paper/references.bib"

with open(YAML_PATH) as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f)

papers = data.get("papers", {})

# Filter: verified=true only
to_include = []
for key, p in papers.items():
    if not p.get("verified", False):
        continue
    to_include.append((key, p))

to_include.sort(key=lambda x: x[1].get("bibtex_key", x[0]))

def fetch_doi_bibtex(doi, timeout=15):
    try:
        r = requests.get(f"https://doi.org/{doi}",
                         headers={"Accept": "application/x-bibtex"},
                         timeout=timeout, allow_redirects=True)
        if r.status_code == 200 and "@" in r.text:
            return r.text.strip()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  DOI fetch failed: {e}", file=sys.stderr)
    return None

def parse_bibtex_fields(bib_text):
    """Extract fields from a BibTeX entry string."""
    fields = {}
    # Get entry type and key
    hdr = re.match(r'@(\w+)\{([^,]+),', bib_text)
    if hdr:
        fields['_type'] = hdr.group(1)
        fields['_key'] = hdr.group(2)
    
    # Extract field=value pairs
    for m in re.finditer(r'(\w+)\s*=\s*\{((?:[^{}]|\{[^{}]*\})*)\}', bib_text):
        fields[m.group(1).lower()] = m.group(2)
    # Also handle bare values like year=2021
    for m in re.finditer(r'(\w+)\s*=\s*(\d{4})', bib_text):
        if m.group(1).lower() not in fields:
            fields[m.group(1).lower()] = m.group(2)
    return fields

def format_authors_from_yaml(authors):
    formatted = []
    for a in authors:
        parts = a.strip().split()
        if len(parts) >= 2:
            last = parts[-1]
            first = " ".join(parts[:-1])
            formatted.append(f"{last}, {first}")
        else:
            formatted.append(a)
    return " and ".join(formatted)

def protect_acronyms(title):
    acronyms = ["LLM", "LLMs", "NER", "IE", "NLP", "GPT", "BERT", "CRF", "FSM", "CFG",
                 "MT", "QA", "OOD", "OOV", "DNN", "DNNs", "CoNLL", "SciERC",
                 "GoLLIE", "UniNER", "SelfCheckGPT", "E-NER", "ReASC", "CISC",
                 "USC", "RASC", "CoCoA", "LSC", "RAPS", "MBR", "BoN", "WNUT"]
    for acr in sorted(acronyms, key=len, reverse=True):
        # Don't double-brace
        title = re.sub(r'(?<!\{)\b' + re.escape(acr) + r'\b(?!\})', '{' + acr + '}', title)
    return title

def determine_entry_type(venue):
    v = venue.lower()
    if any(k in v for k in ["iclr", "icml", "neurips", "nips", "emnlp", "acl ", "naacl", "eacl",
                              "coling", "conll", "aaai", "ijcai", "kdd", "hlt", "workshop", "w-nut",
                              "findings"]):
        return "inproceedings"
    if any(k in v for k in ["journal", "tacl", "bulletin", "transactions", "genomics",
                              "informatics"]):
        return "article"
    if "arxiv" in v or "preprint" in v:
        return "article"
    return "inproceedings"

def build_entry(bkey, etype, title, author, venue_field, venue_val, year, url=None, doi=None):
    lines = [f"@{etype}{{{bkey},"]
    lines.append(f"  title = {{{title}}},")
    lines.append(f"  author = {{{author}}},")
    lines.append(f"  {venue_field} = {{{venue_val}}},")
    lines.append(f"  year = {{{year}}},")
    if doi:
        lines.append(f"  doi = {{{doi}}},")
    if url:
        lines.append(f"  url = {{{url}}}")
    else:
        # remove trailing comma from last line
        lines[-1] = lines[-1].rstrip(',')
    lines.append("}")
    return "\n".join(lines)

# Fetch DOIs
doi_fetched = {}
doi_papers = [(k, p) for k, p in to_include if p.get("doi", "").strip()]
print(f"Fetching {len(doi_papers)} DOIs...", file=sys.stderr)

for key, p in doi_papers:
    doi = p["doi"].strip()
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    print(f"  {bkey}...", file=sys.stderr, end=" ")
    result = fetch_doi_bibtex(doi)
    if result:
        fields = parse_bibtex_fields(result)
        doi_fetched[bkey] = fields
        print("OK", file=sys.stderr)
    else:
        print("FAIL", file=sys.stderr)
    time.sleep(0.3)

# Build all entries
entries = []
supp_count = 0
normal_count = 0

for key, p in to_include:
    bkey = p.get("bibtex_key", key)
    role = p.get("role", "")
    is_supp = role == "supplementary"
    doi = p.get("doi", "").strip()
    
    if bkey in doi_fetched:
        # Use DOI-fetched data but in clean format
        df = doi_fetched[bkey]
        title = df.get("title", p.get("title", ""))
        author = df.get("author", format_authors_from_yaml(p.get("authors", [])))
        year = df.get("year", str(p.get("year", "")))
        
        # Determine type and venue
        etype = df.get("_type", determine_entry_type(p.get("venue", "")))
        if etype == "inproceedings":
            venue_field = "booktitle"
            venue_val = df.get("booktitle", p.get("venue", ""))
        else:
            venue_field = "journal"
            venue_val = df.get("journal", p.get("venue", ""))
        
        url = df.get("url", p.get("url", ""))
        entry = build_entry(bkey, etype, title, author, venue_field, venue_val, year, url, doi)
    else:
        # Build manually from YAML
        title = protect_acronyms(p.get("title", ""))
        author = format_authors_from_yaml(p.get("authors", []))
        year = str(p.get("year", ""))
        venue = p.get("venue", "")
        url = p.get("url", "")
        etype = determine_entry_type(venue)
        
        if etype == "inproceedings":
            venue_field = "booktitle"
            venue_val = venue
        else:
            venue_field = "journal"
            # For arXiv, use standard format
            arxiv_match = re.search(r'arxiv\.org/abs/(\S+)', url)
            if arxiv_match and ("arxiv" in venue.lower() or "preprint" in venue.lower()):
                venue_val = f"arXiv preprint arXiv:{arxiv_match.group(1)}"
            else:
                venue_val = venue
        
        entry = build_entry(bkey, etype, title, author, venue_field, venue_val, year, url, doi if doi else None)
    
    if is_supp:
        entry = f"% SUPPLEMENTARY — not cited in main text\n{entry}"
        supp_count += 1
    else:
        normal_count += 1
    
    entries.append(entry)

# Write
header = "% Auto-generated from literature_map.yaml — do not edit manually\n"
content = header + "\n" + "\n\n".join(entries) + "\n"

with open(BIB_PATH, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    f.write(content)

print(f"\nWritten {len(entries)} entries ({normal_count} normal + {supp_count} supplementary)", file=sys.stderr)
print(f"DOI-fetched: {len(doi_fetched)}, manual: {len(entries) - len(doi_fetched)}", file=sys.stderr)
PYEOF

unverified = [k for k, p in papers.items() if not p.get("verified")]

normal = [k for k, p in papers.items() if p.get("verified") and p.get("role") != "supplementary"]
